goals: Unify Quality scoring models across Lattice, Intent, and UI into a single trait-based engine.
Flatten src/intent module structure to a maximum depth of 3 levels.
Implement Typestate-based phase gating between Discovery and Planning.
Centralize causal tracing and requirement analysis in a side-effect-free lattice module.
Establish a canonical src/domain crate for all shared types and errors.
